description: Wing-body geometry for the wave-drag study, inches. Every value cites its figure or table; derived values are computed by the script, not stored.

sources.l52b08-fig3: NACA RM L52B08, figure 3, printed page 17 (PDF page 19): details of model configurations tested
sources.l52b08-text: NACA RM L52B08, 'Models', printed page 4: 4 percent thick streamwise, aspect ratio 3.5, taper 0.2, NACA 65A thickness
sources.sheet: docs/studies/heldout-geometry.md (lane B), from RM L51I04a figure 3 and RM L51K16a figure 1(a), PDF p. 5

body.noseNote: The three printed numbers over-determine a pointed tangent ogive. The script keeps the diameter and the nose length and derives the ogive radius, (R^2 + L^2) / 2R, and reports its difference from the printed 20 in.
body.stingNote: RM L52B08 figure 3 shows no sting. The sheet gives a 2.25 in sting at the base in both held-out reports; in RM L51K16a it flares 11 13/64 in behind the base, which is behind the last point of every wing, so it lies outside the model's domain of dependence at M 1.60 and is not part of the equivalent body. The body continues as a cylinder (input I4 is not active).

wingPosition.source: l52b08-fig3 prints 16.61 from the nose to the 0.25 point of the mean aerodynamic chord; the sheet gives the same station for every held-out wing (RM L51K16a, PDF p. 5) and the 47 deg apex at 8.748 (RM L51I04a figure 3)
wingPosition.printedRootQuarterChordSource: l52b08-fig3: nose to the 0.25-chord line at the plane of symmetry, one per wing
wingPosition.uncertaintyNote: Input I1: the station is printed as a number, so plus or minus half its last digit (PLAN.md, section 7).

47deg-root12-t06.note: Sheet: 0.12 at the plane of symmetry, tapering linearly to 0.06 at 40 percent of the semispan, 0.06 outboard. Nominal: ordinates interpolated linearly along the span between the two tabulated sections; input I6: the 6 percent section scaled to the local thickness.
